title: Project scaffolding and Docker setup
description: Set up the root docker-compose.yml to orchestrate backend, frontend, and Postgres services. Create Dockerfiles for Go and the frontend. Ensure docker compose up brings up the full stack.

title: Database schema and migrations
description: Write init.sql (or a migration) to create the documents table: id, filename, content type, file size, status (pending/verified/rejected), uploaded_at, updated_at, and any other relevant metadata.

title: Backend API - file upload endpoint
description: Implement a POST /documents endpoint that accepts a PDF or image upload, validates the file type and size, stores it to disk, and inserts a row into Postgres with status pending. Return the document metadata as JSON.

title: Backend API - list documents endpoint
description: Implement a GET /documents endpoint that returns all uploaded documents with their metadata and current status. Support basic filtering/sorting if time allows.

title: Backend API - update document status endpoint
description: Implement a PATCH /documents/:id endpoint that allows a solicitor to update a document's status to verified or rejected.

title: Frontend - document upload page
description: Build a simple upload form that lets a user select a PDF or image and submit it to the backend. Show upload progress and success/error feedback.

title: Frontend - solicitor admin view
description: Build a page listing all uploaded documents with their status. Allow a solicitor to verify or reject a document from this view.

title: Write submission README
description: Document architecture, assumptions, trade-offs, tech choices, and build/run instructions in docs/README.md as required by the brief.

title: Add Dependabot config with grouped updates for Go and TypeScript
